anomalies.description: A person in dark clothing is seen repeatedly striking or restraining another individual who appears helpless on the floor; motion blur and close framing suggest violent physical contact.; A person in dark clothing is seen repeatedly striking or restraining a woman on the floor; she is shown in distress, recoiling, and covering her head across multiple frames.

Two individuals engage in mutual physical struggle: one is on the ground, the other leans over while both appear to grapple; later frames show reciprocal movement and resistance, indicating mutual combat rather than one-sided attack.

The same person in dark clothing is seen bending over the woman lying on the floor, appearing to continue physical assault or restraint; the woman remains in a vulnerable position with visible distress.

Blurred motion and overlapping bodies suggest mutual physical combat between two individuals during the initial frames, though the lack of clear limb positioning prevents high confidence in mutual engagement versus one-sided assault.

A person appears to be physically restraining or assaulting another individual in a close, chaotic struggle; the victim's face is partially visible and shows distress, consistent with abuse of a helpless person.
